primary_sources.finding: Release creation has workflow authorization requirements when targeting a workflow-modifying SHA without an existing branch-head/tag ref.

Current endpoint note compares workflows with default branch, describes403integration as one denial manifestation, and says built-in GITHUB_TOKEN cannot receive required Workflowswrite. Contentswrite alone is not enough for this condition.

Create-reference permissions include Contentswrite and Contentswrite plus Workflowswrite variants; this audit did not establish that a late pin creation for an already-unreferenced workflow-differing SHA would be authorized.

interpretation.classification: Strongly supported explanation of7842, not a provider-internal audit determination.
interpretation.basis: Actual releasecreate403 integration denial + builtin token/Contentswrite + workflow differences versus default + no current head/tag refs match documented restricted condition.
interpretation.historical_limit: No claim all earlier generic gh failures had this cause; their stderr was discarded and original failures had more than one boundary.

safe_remediation_options.option: Already authorized repository-scoped App installation token or fine-grained token with Contentswrite and Workflowswrite, supplied through the restricted publish environment.
safe_remediation_options.benefit: Does not depend on lamp-voice head still equalling the testedSHA after a long build; preserve --target exact testedSHA and all original checksum/signing/immutability checks.
safe_remediation_options.tradeoff: Requires administrator-provisioned existing authorization and secret lifecycle outside this agent; broader permission scope must remain confined to trusted publication step. No credential was located/read/created here.

safe_remediation_options.option: Trusted integrator retains a dedicated immutable-per-build source ref to the exact landed/testedSHA before the ordinary branch head advances, retaining it through publication.
safe_remediation_options.benefit: Addresses the no-existing-ref condition described by official changelog without retargeting an artifact or asking builtin token for nonexistent permission.
safe_remediation_options.tradeoff: Integrator ownership, atomicity/order, ref protection, retention/cleanup and current API behavior need qualification. Creating a new pin only after the SHA lost its lastref is not a proven bootstrap. Pre-build pin jobs can race with rapid branch advancement; do not treat contentswrite as proof of success.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not change release target to current lamp-voice, default branch, or any unverified SHA.
Do not add an unsupported workflows:write grant to built-in GITHUB_TOKEN or bypass artifact/source identity checks.
No ref/tag/release write, credential handling, policy change or workflow rerun was performed.
